text:
sofia (pm): Folks — starting thread for the phased tenant opt‑in + A/B fidelity rollout we discussed. Goal: let customers opt into new routing + quantized model path while keeping strict safety gates. Proposal below, comments pls.

sofia (pm): Phase 0: internal shadow for 24h, mirror traffic 1% of requests (no live responses).
Phase 1: 0.5% live traffic, 10 tenants (opt‑in only), A/B sampling 50/50 (full model vs quantized); 4h bake -> 24h observation.
Phase 2: 5% live, 100 tenants, A/B 70/30 -> evaluate quality drift and latency.
Phase 3: 25% regional ramp with traffic slicing by region and SLA tier.
Phase 4: full roll.
Fallbacks: immediate reroute to primary model, per-tenant kill switch, region fallback to hosted pool.
Gating: p50/p95 latency, token cost delta, quality regression <= 1% top‑line metric.

kai (eng): +1 for opt‑in. two questions: what are the exact metric thresholds and how do we detect noisy signals from small cohorts?

maria (data): Suggest using two metric groups: fidelity (semantic similarity / rerank delta) and business signals (CTR/engagement). For small cohorts use bootstrapped CI and then require sustained signal for 6h before scaling.

raj (sre): Need concrete circuit breaker rules. Proposal: if p95 increases >40% or error rate >0.5% for 10m, automatically divert that tenant to fallback and alert oncall. Also require a manual unblock for region roll beyond 5%.

olivia (prodops): Ops checklist: flag naming convention `ff.region.<region>.tenant_optin.<feature>` and a doc template for customer opt‑in emails. Also add a GAQ (go‑no‑go) row in the shiproom with owners: PM, Eng, Data, SRE, Support.

sofia (pm): Example flag payload we want deployers to create — keep simple:
```json
{"flag": "ff.eu.tenant_optin.new_routing", "default": false, "allowed_tenants": ["acct_123"], "metadata": {"phase": "1", "owner": "sofia"}}
```

kai (eng): For rollout infra: we'll need automated checklist hooks that evaluate the metrics and can flip flag via an API. I can add a small service to query telemetry and set flags, with a manual override UI.

raj (sre): Also request a dark path that rates limits KV cache warming: when diverting to quantized path we should warm cache async and throttle to avoid thundering herd. Default throttle 20rps per tenant during warmup.

maria (data): For A/B analysis: baseline window = 48h pre, rolling test window = 24h; use hedged permutation test and report p-values + effect sizes in the roll dashboard. Automate alerts when effect size > 0.02 for core metric.

olivia (prodops): Customer comms: early adopters get a toggle in console + short FAQ. Need templated rollback email and support playbook. I'll draft.

deploy-bot: Created feature flag `ff.eu.tenant_optin.new_routing` in staging at 1768529999.

sofia (pm): Open action items: 1) kai: infra hooks + API (ETA Tue) 2) maria: draft metric gating doc & thresholds (ETA Mon) 3) raj: circuit breaker implementation + warmup throttle (ETA Wed) 4) olivia: comms + flag naming guide (ETA Fri). Add any other asks here. :running: :white_check_mark:

kai (eng): I'll also add a small smoke test traffic generator for the 0.5% canary to stress the path.

raj (sre): I'll add oncall playbook snippet for automatic diverts and postmortem template.

maria (data): Will add the analysis notebook and hook into the rollout dashboard.

olivia (prodops): I'll put the customer opt‑in form in the console staging and send draft comms to #customer-success for review.

sofia (pm): Thanks all. If no major objections by EOD I'll schedule the internal shadow for next Tue and kick off the infra PRs.

kai (eng): No objections from eng.

raj (sre): No objections from SRE.

maria (data): 👍

olivia (prodops): 👍
